scope: Integrated review of the exact 24 identities, 23 bounded components and source-bound evidence; root reads plus three bounded cross-reviews, not a capability certificate
foundation_cross_review: Foundation owner independently read the seven Agent/collaboration modules and their defining equations; this review was reported to root and does not replace actual CUDA evidence

resolved_findings.finding: Blocksworld goal-prefix matching accepted covered singleton goals and a held obstacle
resolved_findings.resolution: Require an exact clear goal tower and empty hand; independently verify one/two covering blocks and held-obstacle completion with BFS

resolved_findings.finding: Frozen raw validator did not reject some contradictory labels or an existing per-seed device field
resolved_findings.resolution: Separate unfrozen admission gate rejects conflicting device, diagnostic, pretrained-call, Evolve, retry and full-experiment claims before receipt materialization; mutation tests added

resolved_findings.finding: Standalone collection of two new tests depended on another test adding scripts to sys.path
resolved_findings.resolution: Make script-path setup explicit; isolated test collection and execution pass

resolved_findings.finding: Five authored deep-dive comparisons referenced papers outside their declared topic
resolved_findings.resolution: Reread suitable same-topic sources, rewrite both languages and synchronize exact source/unit fingerprints; retain the existing strict validator

evidence_boundaries.gold_role: Completed-output evaluators and training-loss targets only; no evaluated actor receives scoring keys through the provided interfaces. Typed boundaries are not a security sandbox
evidence_boundaries.cost_policy: No checkpoint/media download, commercial API or full campaign was launched. Twenty-two full campaigns are high-cost not reproduced; one private-training dependency is separately closed

source_inventory_review.role: Isotoken message-budget bookkeeping, not tool execution or task-success evidence
